title: Structured Response owns the common result envelope
summary: Cognitive Continuity v0.7 corrects the ownership boundary: Structured Response is the common request/result/occurrence representation beneath abilities and presentation. Structured Utterance production is a typed domain result carried by that response; Cognitive Continuity consumes/emits Structured Responses but owns admission/retention rather than the common envelope.
invariants: Structured Response owns common request/result/receipt, evidence/warning/error/provenance, timing and authority semantics.
Structured Utterance owns utterance structure, generation intent and information-use lineage; its production result is a domain payload, not a common response envelope.
Cognitive proposal data is a domain result carried by Structured Response, not a peer response protocol.
Cognitive Continuity owns durable cognitive admission, scope, authority and retention.
Model output cannot self-promote to verified authority or completion evidence.
Brand code must not invent a standalone common Structured Response envelope while its owning platform implementation is absent.
procedure: Producer-side Brand code emits typed domain payloads only.
The external Structured Response owner carries the payload using its exact common-field vocabulary.
Cognitive or other domain admission is applied separately after representation.

provenance.claim: Structured Response owns common occurrence representation; Cognitive Continuity owns durable cognitive admission rather than a competing envelope.
Cognitive proposal is a domain result carried by Structured Response and exact common-field vocabulary remains owned by the Structured Response API.
Producer candidate adds structured.utterance.production-result/0.1 as a domain payload while excluding common response envelope fields.
